```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

#suppressMessages(library(xlsx))
library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(fgsea)
library(data.table)
library(homologene)
library(GSVA)

result_folder = "../../../../Results/ClonalCultures/RNA/"
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

library(ggvenn)
```

```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "DGE_analysis_image.Rdata"))
norm_counts = read.table(file.path(result_folder, "Normalized_expression_data.txt"), sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
colnames(norm_counts) = gsub("Row.names", "Geneid", colnames(norm_counts))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
gsea_gmt_file = "../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/MSigDB/msigdb_v2023.2.Hs_GMTs/msigdb.v2023.2.Hs.entrez.gmt"
gsets <- gmtPathways(gsea_gmt_file)
```


```{r}
cdx2_gs_names = names(gsets)[grepl("CDX2",names(gsets))]

cdx2_sets = gsets[cdx2_gs_names]
cdx2_sets[["BOYD_CDX2_TARGETS"]] = fread("../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/TargetGenes/CDX2/unique_cdx2_target_genes.txt", header=F)$V1

tmp_env = new.env()
load("../../../../Data/ExtData/Singh_HNF4A_CDX2/Results/2022-10-27/DGE_analysis_image.Rdata", envir = tmp_env)
tmp_res = get("all_results", tmp_env)
m2h_t = mouse2human(tmp_res[[1]]$GeneSymbol, db=homologeneData2)
m2h = tapply(m2h_t$humanGene, m2h_t$mouseGene, function(x) paste(x, collapse=","))

m2h_f = function(x) m2h[as.character(x[!is.na(x) & !x=="NA" & !x==""])]

cdx2_sets[["SINGH_CDX2_UP"]] = m2h_f(subset(tmp_res[["CDX2_vs_GFP"]], padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0)$GeneSymbol)
cdx2_sets[["SINGH_CDX2_DN"]] = m2h_f(subset(tmp_res[["CDX2_vs_GFP"]], padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0)$GeneSymbol)
cdx2_sets[["SINGH_HNF4A_UP"]] = m2h_f(subset(tmp_res[["HNF4A_vs_GFP"]], padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0)$GeneSymbol)
cdx2_sets[["SINGH_HNF4A_DN"]] = m2h_f(subset(tmp_res[["HNF4A_vs_GFP"]], padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0)$GeneSymbol)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_comparisons = c("IM_vs_non-IM_all_samples","IM_591_vs_NonIM","IM_592_vs_NonIM","IM_594_vs_NonIM","IM_all_vs_NormalAntrum","Colon_vs_HealthyAntrum","Duod_vs_HealthyAntrum")
fc_threshold = 0.5
for (n in sel_comparisons) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  r_up = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  r_down = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  
  for (gs in names(cdx2_sets)) {
    set_genes = cdx2_sets[[gs]]
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_UP_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_up$GeneSymbol)  
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_DOWN_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_down$GeneSymbol)
    
    ll = list()
    ll[[gs]]=set_genes
    ll[[paste0(n,"_UP")]] = r_up$GeneSymbol
    ll[[paste0(n,"_DOWN")]] = r_down$GeneSymbol
    
    p = ggvenn(ll, set_name_size = 4) 
    print(p)
    
  }
}
  
  
```

```{r}
lapply(all_ovlp[grep("SINGH_CDX2_UP", names(all_ovlp))], sort)
#lapply(all_ovlp[grep("SINGH_CDX2_DN", names(all_ovlp))], sort)
```
# GSVA

```{r}
count_mat = as.matrix(norm_counts[,grepl("^X4", colnames(norm_counts))])
rownames(count_mat) <- norm_counts$GeneSymbol
res_gsva = gsva(count_mat, cdx2_sets)
colnames(res_gsva) = ed[gsub("^X","", colnames(res_gsva)), "Library.Name"]
```

```{r, fig.width=12}

pheatmap(res_gsva)
pheatmap(res_gsva[c("SINGH_CDX2_UP","SINGH_HNF4A_UP"),])
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
tmp <- res_gsva[c("SINGH_CDX2_UP"),]
par(mar=c(15,4,4,1))
barplot(sort(tmp), las=2, cex.names = .9)
```
